statement: ICE Brent front-month futures settle above 100.00 USD per barrel on 2026-10-16. Reference: 100.03 on the packet date.
resolution: True if the ICE Brent front-month settlement price published for 2026-10-16 is strictly above 100.00. Reference: 100.03 on the packet date.
failure_condition: The ICE Brent front-month settlement for 2026-10-16 is at or below 100.00.

control_basis.rule: climatological — same probability for every row drawn from the same reference class
control_basis.note: pre-registered before the outcome existed. This is the floor the forecaster arm must clear; it is not an attempt to be right.

statement: The FRED DGS10 series value for 2026-10-15 is at or above 5.00 percent. Reference: 4.96 percent on the packet date.
resolution: True if the FRED series DGS10 observation dated 2026-10-15 is at or above 5.00. Reference: 4.96 percent on the packet date.
failure_condition: The DGS10 observation for 2026-10-15 is below 5.00 percent.
